searchText: Following up on the breakout room for EVM 384 & BLS discussion. my understanding from the ACD meeting is that we want to get answers to a few open questions: - Clients’ general thoughts on EVM 384 & BLS12-381 & BLS12-377 curves - Readiness on individual proposals - Document concerns on (a) the performance difference (b) Implementation/upgrade readiness - Thoughts on monthly discussion on EVM 384, & BLS curve progress (frequency/week day/ time). The *process of inclusion* is a “process” topic that could be brainstormed in the EIPIP meetings first and then will bring to the core devs/breakout room meeting discussion. Thoughts on the call date/time for the first breakout room (EVM384 - BLS 12-381 & BLS12-377 curves) meeting?
